scripts.hooks:install: git config set --local hook.fts-verify.command 'npm run verify:commit' && git config set --local --all hook.fts-verify.event pre-commit
scripts.verify: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names commit,test "npm run verify:commit" "npm test" && npm run build
scripts.verify:commit: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names format,lint,types "npm run format:check" "npm run lint" "npm run check"
